away.summary: The Blackhawks (4-11-1) are projected to start Arvid Soderblom in the second half of a back-to-back after Spencer Knight made 24 saves in a 5-3 loss to Florida on Wednesday. Patrick Kane (upper body) and Bowen Byram (upper body) are out, while Kevin Korchinski and Andrew Mangiapane are listed as scratched.

doubtful.detail: lower body, listed as questionable after missing Tuesday's game against Detroit

home.summary: The Lightning (9-3-2) are projected to start Andrei Vasilevskiy, with Dennis Hildeby listed as the backup. Yanni Gourde (hip) is out, and Zemgus Girgensons (lower body) is questionable after missing Tuesday's game against Detroit. Max Crozier and Scott Sabourin are scratched.
